Add one zone per lane, then “Aim”: you have 3 s to place the mouse on the lane’s hit line.

ui.Cette langue n'est pas installée pour l': This language is not installed for Windows OCR. Windows Settings › Time & language › Language › Add a language (for Japanese, optical character recognition is enough), or in an administrator PowerShell:
ui.Chaque collection a son étagère sur l'ac: Each collection has its own shelf on the home screen, in this order, and works as a filter in the library. A game is in it if you add it (here or from its page) or if it matches its rules: tags, circle, author… with “or” groups and exclusions. Chosen games are saved immediately; name, rules and display with “Save”.
ui.Chaque collection doit avoir un nom, dif: Each collection needs a name, different from the others.
ui.Chaque jeu tourne dans sa propre sandbox: Each game runs in its own sandbox: what it writes outside its folder (AppData, registry) is isolated there instead of cluttering Windows. Its folder stays directly accessible (local saves, patches). It is not a virtual machine: it limits the damage a dubious executable can do without making it impossible.
ui.Chiffrée par Windows, jamais affichée ni: Encrypted by Windows, never shown or sent anywhere else. Saved immediately.
ui.Choisis le fichier ou l’application avec: Pick the file or app with “Browse”: for security, a path typed by hand isn’t saved.
ui.Clics à intervalle régulier, au curseur: Clicks at a regular interval, at the cursor or on a fixed point — hotkey {hotkey}.
ui.Clique (ou appuie sur une touche) quand: Clicks (or presses a key) when a note crosses a zone — hotkey {hotkey}.
ui.Clique quand une note passe dans une zon: Clicks when a note crosses a zone. An indicator will appear at the bottom left and the zones will be outlined on the game (green on each click): {hotkey} starts / stops.
ui.Clé enregistrée — en saisir une autre: Key saved — type another one to replace it
ui.Coche « Activer l'auto-clicker », puis,: Tick “Enable the auto-clicker”, then, in game (launched from DLSGM), open the overlay with {shift} + {tab} and tick “Add the auto-clicker to this game” (remembered for later sessions). {key} only works in those games, and clicks only go to the game: if another window comes to the foreground (Alt+Tab, desktop), the auto-clicker pauses (orange dot) instead of clicking elsewhere.
ui.Code affiché sur l'autre PC: Code shown on the other PC
ui.Code à saisir sur l'autre PC: Code to enter on the other PC
ui.Copie les dossiers de sauvegarde détecté: Copies the detected save folders (game page › Tools) into DLSGM's data at the end of each session, if anything changed. The last 10 automatic copies are kept per game; restore them from the game page.
ui.Copie les jeux choisis (dossier, fiche e: Copies the chosen games (folder, entry and images) to a PC that has receiving open. Your rating, tags and play time stay on this PC.
ui.Copier les sauvegardes à la fermeture d': Back up saves when a game closes
ui.Copiés, mais impossibles à supprimer de: Copied, but could not be deleted from the old folder (file in use?): {names}. You can delete them yourself.
ui.Couleurs de l'interface, du logo et de l: Colors of the interface, the logo and the icon. “Random” picks a theme at every startup, “Super random turbo 2000 remix” makes up the colors at every startup.
ui.DLsite n'a renvoyé aucune donnée : souve: DLsite returned no data: often a region-locked work, only visible from Japan.
ui.DLsite répond, mais avec une erreur HTTP: DLsite responds, but with HTTP error {status}.

Different from the other tools’ hotkeys.
ui.Dossier des jeux non configuré ou introu: The games folder is not set or cannot be found. Please set it in the settings.
ui.Délais mesurés — dernier démarrage : {st: Measured delays — last start: {start} ms (key press → first click), last stop: {stop} ms. Details in auto-clicker.log (DLSGM data folder).
ui.Démarre un enregistrement, puis l'arrête: Starts a recording, then stops it: the macro is added to the game and becomes the one to replay.
ui.Déplacer tous les jeux de la bibliothèqu: Move every game of the library to another folder
ui.Désinstaller le patch « {name} » ? Les f: Uninstall the patch “{name}”? The original files still backed up are restored.
ui.Détecteur de rythme à l'arrêt — {hotkey}: Rhythm detector stopped — {hotkey} to start, click to set up zones
ui.En jeu, place la souris où cliquer et ap: In game, place the mouse where to click and press {key} to start; {key} again to stop. The indicator at the bottom left of the game window shows the state (green running, orange paused, red stopped); when stopped, clicking it adjusts the interval and hotkey.
ui.En pause (le jeu n’est pas au premier pl: Paused (the game is not in the foreground).
ui.En pause : le jeu n’est pas au premier p: Paused: the game is not in the foreground
ui.Enregistre clics et touches dans le jeu,: Records clicks and keys in the game, then replays them — {record} records, {play} replays.
ui.Enregistre tes clics et touches dans le: Records your clicks and keys in the game, then replays them: {record} records, {play} replays the macro chosen below.
ui.Espace libre sur le disque de destinatio: Free space on the destination drive: {free}.
ui.Extraire des archives de jeux (.zip, .ra: Extract game archives (.zip, .rar, .7z, .part1.exe) into the library folder
ui.Extrait le texte des visual novels et RP: Extracts the text of visual novels and RPG Maker games (engines BepInEx translation does not cover). The thread chosen in the overlay (Shift+Tab) goes to the clipboard and/or to textractor/ in the workspace folder.
ui.F11, le bouton en haut à droite ou le bo: F11, the top-right button or the controller’s View button toggle full screen at any time.
ui.Ferme l'overlay et joue : clics et touch: Close the overlay and play: clicks and keys made in the game are recorded. {hotkey} to finish.
ui.Fermer la fenêtre la cache au lieu de qu: Closing the window hides it instead of quitting: play-time tracking, save backups and local network receiving keep running. Click the icon to reopen it, or “Quit” in its menu to quit.
ui.Filtrer la bibliothèque par ce genre: Filter the library by this genre
ui.Gardées (note, temps de jeu, images) et: Kept (rating, play time, images) but hidden from the library: they reappear if the folder comes back.
ui.Gestionnaire de mots de passe : quand un: Password manager: when an archive is protected, DLSGM first tries the passwords guessed from its name (distribution site) and its text files, then these ones, before asking you for the password.
ui.Glisse les images pour les réorganiser,: Drag images to reorder them, or onto the cover to replace it (the star does the same).
ui.Hors du Japon : les œuvres réservées au: Outside Japan: Japan-only works will probably stay unavailable.
ui.Hors jeu : {hotkey} n'agit que pendant u: Not in game: {hotkey} only works while a game launched from DLSGM (with the auto-clicker allowed) is running. Click to adjust.

ui.IDs ou liens DLsite à ajouter: DLsite IDs or links to add
ui.Ignoré (format non pris en charge — JPEG: Ignored (unsupported format — JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP): {files}
ui.Il semblerait que cette collection soit: This collection seems to be empty.
ui.Interrupteur général ; il s'ajoute ensui: Master switch; it is then added game by game (Shift+Tab overlay, “Add the auto-clicker to this game” checkbox). Clicks only go to the game (paused if another window is in the foreground).

Master switch; it is then added game by game (Shift+Tab overlay, “Add the macro recorder to this game” checkbox), where the macro to replay is chosen. Only clicks and keys made in the game while it is in the foreground are recorded, and nothing is replayed elsewhere.

Master switch; it is then added game by game (Shift+Tab overlay, “Add the rhythm detector to this game” checkbox), where its zones are set up too. Nothing is sent if the game is not in the foreground.
ui.Jeu 64 bits : Locale Emulator ne gère qu: 64-bit game: Locale Emulator only handles 32-bit games, the launch will be refused.
ui.Jeu importé. Mettre son archive à la cor: Game imported. Move its archive to the recycle bin?
ui.L'ancien nom (version, DLC) reste visibl: The old name (version, DLC) stays visible on the game page. An existing folder is never overwritten.
ui.L'auto-clicker n'est disponible que sous: The auto-clicker is only available on Windows.
ui.L'historique des sessions commence à la: Session history starts with the next game launched from DLSGM.
ui.L'écran est lu une fois par rafraîchisse: The screen is read once per refresh (60 times per second on a 60 Hz display): a note is seen up to ~17 ms after it appears — each zone’s “delay” realigns the action with the hit line. Games in exclusive full screen are not visible (windowed or borderless full screen only), and input does not reach a game run as administrator unless DLSGM is too.
ui.LAN : adresses de ce PC sur chaque résea: LAN: this PC’s addresses on each network. WAN: your public IP as DLsite sees it (proxy / VPN included), asked from the ipinfo.io service when you click Check.
ui.La fenêtre du jeu seule, dans le dossier: The game window only, in the game’s workspace folder (captures/) — hotkey {hotkey}.
ui.Label: Label
ui.Lance la macro choisie (une fois ou en b: Plays the chosen macro (once or in a loop), or stops it. Alt+Space (panic) stops everything and discards a recording in progress.
ui.Langue affichée : {name}. Changer de lan: Current language: {name}. Changing the language reloads the window.
ui.Le dictionnaire ne sert que pour le japo: The dictionary only works for Japanese.
ui.Le dossier où vivent tes jeux : un sous-: The folder where your games live: one subfolder per work, named exactly after its DLsite ID (e.g. RJ01234567). DLSGM looks for games there, extracts imported archives into it and receives games shared over the local network there.
ui.Le fil choisi dans l'overlay (Maj+Tab) p: The thread chosen in the overlay (Shift+Tab) goes to the clipboard (for a dictionary or translator), to a daily file in the workspace folder, or both.
ui.Le sens de chaque mot et de chaque kanji: The meaning of each word and each kanji (not a translated sentence), with furigana readings; a detailed card when hovering a word. Offline: nothing leaves this PC. Japanese only; meanings in French when JMdict has them, otherwise in English.
ui.Le texte reconnu (jamais l'image) est en: The recognized text (never the image) is sent to {service} on each reading.
ui.Lecture en pause (le jeu n’est pas au pr: Playback paused (the game is not in the foreground).
ui.Les fiches sont récupérées en japonais,: Entries are fetched in Japanese, DLsite’s reference language; each tag is identified by its Japanese name. English is only a display translation (Library › Tag language), learned from DLsite on each fetch. Correct a translation here: it becomes manual and DLsite no longer replaces it.
ui.Les fiches sont toujours récupérées en j: Entries are always fetched in Japanese (the reference language), with DLsite's English translation. Choose the language tags are shown in; titles and circles stay in Japanese (search also finds their English names).
ui.Les informations et les images seront re: The information and images will be replaced by DLsite’s, including your manual edits (unsaved changes in this form are lost). Your rating, tags, play time and chosen executable are kept. If DLsite does not respond, nothing is changed.
ui.Les jaquettes R18 restent floutées dans: R18 covers stay blurred in the grid until clicked.
ui.Les jeux finis sont masqués — cliquer po: Finished games are hidden — click to show them
ui.Les jeux sortent de la liste tout seuls: Games leave the list on their own as soon as they arrive in the library.
ui.Les positions de la souris sont relative: Mouse positions are relative to the game window (it can move between recording and playback, but not change size). Mouse moves are only kept while a button is held. Input does not reach a game run as administrator unless DLSGM is too.
ui.Lit le texte du jeu (OCR de Windows) et: Reads the game’s text (Windows OCR) and shows its translation on top — hotkey {hotkey}.
ui.Locale Emulator introuvable (Paramètres: Locale Emulator not found (Settings › Launch): the game cannot be launched.
ui.Maj+Tab pendant une partie lancée depuis: Shift+Tab while playing a game launched from DLSGM — this is where the tools below are added to a game.
ui.Marqué comme fini — cliquer pour annuler: Marked as finished — click to undo
ui.Même disque : les dossiers sont simpleme: Same drive: the folders are simply moved, it's instant.
ui.Ni une adresse web, ni un chemin complet: Neither a web address nor a full path: nothing will be opened.
Number of clicks before stopping automatically.
ui.Ouvre un port sur ce PC pour qu'un autre: Opens a port on this PC so another PC on the local network can drop games into it, straight into the library folder. A game that is already here is never overwritten. Receiving closes when DLSGM closes.
PIA was not found on this PC.
ui.Par défaut, celle du système si l'interf: By default, the system language if the interface is translated into it, otherwise English. Changing the language reloads the window.
ui.Pas de traduction française dans JMdict: No French translation in JMdict: meanings in English.
ui.Pendant une partie lancée depuis DLSGM,: While playing a game launched from DLSGM, the hotkey captures the game window (not the whole screen) into <workspace>/<ID>/captures/: never sent over the network, kept if the game is deleted. Gallery on the game page and in the overlay. DLSGM's indicators and windows don't appear in screenshots.

While playing a game launched from DLSGM, the hotkey reads the text in the game window with Windows OCR and shows its translation on top; pressing it again (or Esc) hides it. Also available in the overlay (Shift+Tab).
ui.Pour un jeu aux textes illisibles, qui p: For a game with garbled text, that crashes on start or cannot find its files on a non-Japanese Windows. Play time is still tracked.
ui.Pour « Lancer avec Textractor » (page du: For “Launch with Textractor” (game page): the Textractor folder, with its x86 and x64 subfolders (TextractorCLI.exe).
ui.Pour « Lancer en japonais » (page du jeu: For “Launch in Japanese” (game page): games that expect a Japanese Windows (garbled text, crash on start, misnamed files) run in the Japanese locale without changing the PC's. 32-bit games only. Run LEInstaller.exe once after unzipping it.
ui.Prêt : {hotkey} démarre / arrête la surv: Ready: {hotkey} starts / stops watching (indicator at the bottom left).
ui.Quelques réglages pour commencer. Tout r: A few settings to get started. Everything can be changed later in Settings.
ui.Quelques secondes après le lancement, DL: A few seconds after launch, DLSGM checks GitHub for a new version and offers to install it (installed version) or announces it (portable version). Nothing is downloaded without your consent.
ui.Rejouée en boucle jusqu’à l’arrêt: Replayed in a loop until stopped
ui.Relit périodiquement le cache pour affic: Periodically re-reads the cache to show data updated in the background.
ui.Remettre la couverture parmi les images: Move the cover back to the images
ui.Remplace les informations et les images: Replaces the information and images with DLsite’s
ui.Remplacer les sauvegardes actuelles par: Replace the current saves with the copy from {date}? The current state is copied first (“Before restore”), so the restore can be undone.
ui.Règle le clic dans {where} : intervalle,: Set up the click in {where}: interval, button, single or double click, number of repeats, and where to click (at the cursor or a fixed point) — then Save.
ui.Récupère à nouveau chaque fiche depuis D: Fetches every entry again from DLsite in Japanese (the reference language), with the English translations: a library fetched in several languages becomes consistent again (e.g. “cat 3” and “猫3”, same circle), the tag dictionary fills up, and older entries gain the circle ID. An entry whose fetch fails (delisted work, region lock) stays as it is. The database is copied to userData/db_backups before starting.
ui.Récupération depuis DLsite impossible, f: Could not fetch from DLsite, entry unchanged: {error}
ui.Récupérer à nouveau la fiche depuis DLsi: Fetch this entry again from DLsite?
ui.Récupérer à nouveau les métadonnées de t: Fetch the metadata of every entry again from DLsite, in Japanese with their English translations?
ui.Réessayer les échecs via Private Interne: Retry failures through Private Internet Access
ui.Régler la collection (jeux, règles, affi: Set up the collection (games, rules, display)

ui.Si Windows demande l'autorisation du par: If Windows asks for firewall permission, allow private networks. The transfer is not encrypted: only use it on a trusted network.
ui.Si le jeu tourne en administrateur, Wind: If the game runs as administrator, Windows blocks clicks from an app that does not: then run DLSGM as administrator too. Some games ignore simulated clicks, or clicks that are too fast: increase the interval (50–100 ms is usually enough).
ui.Supprime et retélécharge toutes les jaqu: Deletes and downloads again every cover and image from DLsite. Irreversible, and may take a while.
ui.Supprimer et retélécharger toutes les ja: Delete and download again every cover and image from DLsite? This cannot be undone and may take a while.
ui.Supprimer la collection (les jeux ne son: Delete the collection (games are not affected)
ui.Sur l'interface sombre, les couleurs tro: On the dark interface, colors that are too dark are lightened to stay readable.
ui.Tester l’accès à DLsite avec ce proxy: Test access to DLsite through this proxy
ui.Texte reconnu seulement, sans traduction: Recognized text only, without translation (nothing leaves this PC).
ui.Textractor introuvable (Paramètres › Lan: Textractor not found (Settings › Launch): the game cannot be launched.
ui.Titres, cercles et tags passeront tous e: Titles, circles and tags will all switch to Japanese (the reference language). Images, ratings, personal tags, play time and collections are left untouched, as are manually edited entries. The database is backed up first.
ui.Tu peux aussi le choisir plus tard (Para: You can also choose it later (Settings › Library).
ui.Téléchargé une fois, puis utilisé sans c: Downloaded once, then used offline. Data from {source} (CC BY-SA 4.0), via jmdict-simplified.
ui.Un raccourci, valable partout : réduit t: One shortcut that works everywhere: minimizes every window (the game included), mutes the sound and opens your work window. Pressing it again puts the windows back as they were. Alt+Space remains the simple panic (DLSGM only).
ui.Un sous-dossier par jeu (<ID>) pour rang: One subfolder per game (<ID>) to keep your own work on it (data mining, extractions, notes), opened from its page. Outside the game folder: never sent over the network, never touched by patches, never deleted.
ui.Un témoin s'affichera en bas à gauche de: An indicator will appear at the bottom left of the game window: {hotkey} starts / stops clicking, clicking the indicator (when stopped) adjusts the interval and hotkey.
ui.Une adresse web (https://…), ou une appl: A web address (https://…), or an application or document to open. Empty: nothing opens, the desktop stays empty.
A collection with this name already exists.
ui.Une prochaine version se branchera de fa: A future version will connect to a VPN more reliably (SOCKS5, OpenVPN or WireGuard). Meanwhile, for Japan-only works: turn your VPN on to Japan (e.g. PIA, region jp-tokyo) before starting a scan or “Update all entries”, and leave the proxy empty.
ui.Une œuvre à restriction régionale ne rép: A region-locked work does not respond outside Japan and looks like it does not exist. With this option, failed entries (scan, bulk update) are fetched again by connecting PIA to Japan for the duration of the requests, then PIA goes back to its previous state. PIA must be open (or “piactl background enable”). The VPN applies to the whole PC during those few seconds.
ui.Unity IL2CPP : traduction auto non prise: Unity IL2CPP: auto translation not supported (requires BepInEx 6).
ui.Utilisé pour les fiches et les images DL: Always used for DLsite entries and images (e.g. a Japanese proxy for region-locked works). None: the Windows proxy. The password is encrypted (Windows) and never shown again. A browser proxy (extension) has no effect here; its address is needed.
